units.source_text: 吃完饭，女人又回到水槽边，把塑料布顶在头上，在那下面偷偷地吃自己那份。

en.t: After finishing the meal, the woman went back to the sink, held the plastic sheet over her head, and secretly ate her own portion beneath it.
The sight of her back made him think of a mole cricket.

units.source_text: 难道她打算把这样的生活一直继续下去吗？

en.t: Could she really mean to go on living this way forever?

units.source_text: ……从外面看起来，也许只有巴掌大小一块土地，可是站在洞底看，满眼皆是无边无际的沙子和天空。

en.t: ...Seen from outside, it might be no more than a palm-sized patch of land, but standing at the bottom of the pit, all one could see was endless sand and sky.

units.source_text: 像幽闭进眼中的单调生活……

en.t: A monotonous life, as if shut inside the eyes...

units.source_text: 这之中，女人一定没有半点听别人说怜悯话的记忆吧……

en.t: In all of this, the woman surely had not the slightest memory of ever hearing words of pity from anyone...

units.source_text: 能够照顾落入陷阱的男人，说不定她会像年轻姑娘似的，心里“扑扑”跳个不停呢……

en.t: Being able to care for a man who had fallen into the trap, perhaps her heart was pounding away like a young girl's...
